svg.text: the words of BGE 19, sorted by the reading each favours
political vocabulary
befehlen / gehorchen — command / obey (six times)
„ich bin frei, ‚er' muss gehorchen" — a "he" obeys
Unterwillen, Unter-Seelen — under-wills, under-souls
Gesellschaftsbau vieler Seelen — society of many souls
Gemeinwesen — commonwealth
die regierende Klasse — the ruling class
Herrschafts-Verhältnisse — relations of dominance
L'effet c'est moi — the king's sentence, altered
used for: rank as authority, a party that
can refuse, "obeys, or that he believes to obey"
causal and affective vocabulary
Affekt des Commando's — the affect of command
Überlegenheits-Affekt — affect of superiority
Wirkung des Befehls — the effect of the command
Nothwendigkeit von Wirkung — necessity of effect
Machtgefühl, Lustgefühle — feeling of power, pleasure
Werkzeuge — instruments
Zwingen, Drängen, Drücken — compulsion, pressure
irrthümliche Schlüsse — erroneous conclusions
used for: the felt side as an effect and a
misreading; command as a cause among causes
absent from BGE 19: Grund (reason), Rechtfertigung (justification), Recht (right) of a drive to rule.
The one legitimacy word is in BGE 6: each drive "would only too gladly present itself as the
legitimate master (berechtigten Herrn) of all the other drives" — inside a clause about self-presentation.
both columns are Nietzsche's; the section never says which column the other is reducible to
